title: Swimming Program
transcript:
Speaker 1: Good morning. How can I help you?
Speaker 2: Good morning. I’m new in Bradfort town and I want to find out information about the swimming pools here. The weather’s getting hot, I really want to go swimming. Maybe I can sign up for swimming lessons to improve my skills. My swimming skills are a little rusty.
Speaker 1: Sure. There are three pools in town. I’m sure there will be one that suits your needs.
Speaker 2: What are they like?
Speaker 1: The first one is called Happy Summer which is mainly for young children. It was opened this May, so it’s quite new.
Speaker 2: Oh, how big is it?
Speaker 1: The pool is about 50 meters in length. So it’s big enough. There’s a café, too. You can have a cup of soft drink when you finish swimming.
Speaker 2: It all sounds quite nice.
Speaker 1: I have to tell you there is no parking lot nearby. So if you drive there, you may spend some time looking for a parking location.
Speaker 2: Right. That can be a problem. I don’t want to do on-street parking. It’s kind of expensive. What are the other options?
Speaker 1: Blue Ocean is quite good. It opens to swimmers of entry level.
Speaker 2: Oh, I guess I might belong at this level. How deep is the pool?
Speaker 1: They have areas where the water is quite deep, about 3 meters in depth. And they have changing rooms for you, so it’s quite convenient. You don’t have to change in the bathrooms.
Speaker 2: Good. When does it open? I only have time in the evenings.
Speaker 1: In the evenings? I’m afraid it opens from 9 am to 5 pm every day.
Speaker 2: That’s too bad. Their timetable doesn’t work with me. My daily business meetings finish at 5. And it usually takes me half an hour to get there.
Speaker 1: How about Water Bay? It opens from 2pm to 9pm. And it provides free lockers for your stuff.
Speaker 2: Is it open to beginners?
Speaker 1: Yes, actually it’s only accessible for adult learners who enroll in the swimming courses there.
Speaker 2: Oh, I might consider that. I don’t feel comfortable if I have to learn swimming with a group of kids. Are there any drawbacks?
Speaker 1: Usually, a lot of people take part in their training program, so the pool gets a little crowded, especially in summer. But if you take the training in winter, the situation is much better.
Speaker 2: I guess it’s not a big problem, and I really don’t have much of a choice.
Speaker 1: So, as I said, you have to sign up for their training course, if you want to go swimming there.
Speaker 2: Yeah, I understand. What is the course like? Do I get a personal trainer?
Speaker 3: Yes. Their trainers will train you 3 times a week according to your schedule. You can pick three days of a week, but you can’t change the scheduled days. Currently, there are 8 personal trainers, remember to schedule with them at least one week in advance.
Speaker 2: I see.
Speaker 1: The training sessions start at half past five on those days. So, arrive early to warm up.
Speaker 2: I will keep that in mind. How much is the course?
Speaker 1: Hmmm, it’s $1000 for a 2-month program. With their membership, you can get a discount. And if you need a transportation service to pick you up, there’s an extra cost for this. But, their membership will cover it for you.
Speaker 2: I don’t need that. My house is just three blocks away from Water Bay. I can ride a bicycle there.
Speaker 1: Alright, if you need further information, you can call Water Bay’s hotline, which is 99087668.
Speaker 2: Thanks for letting me know.
